name: dp-it-normativa-ingest
description: Loads the convert plan files into the ds_it_normativa dataset: history replaced, units / acts / akn_documents upserted, one transaction per act. Embeddings kept when the text is unchanged.
author: open-lex-it

execute.description: For each item read <dirIn>/<stem>.plan.json and .akn.xml, write the act in one transaction. A failed act is rolled back; the run ends with system_error listing the failed keys.

items.description: the acts to load, as reported by the detect step

connString.description: dataset connection string (Npgsql or libpq), never logged

collectionPriority.description: collection labels, most important first; an existing label is never downgraded

output.description: { metrics: {acts, written.<schema>.<table>}, acts: [{key, act_urn, units, version_rows}] }
